description: Run the paid checks you need at ONE pinned block and get one evidence bundle back - safety, route, quotecheck, depth, or any combination. Cheaper than buying each separately. Pass you only what you need: an unsupplied check is reported as notChecked, not guessed. Costs $0.10 per call; the supplied parts total $0.12.

chainId.description: REQUIRED. 1 Ethereum, 42161 Arbitrum, 8453 Base. There is no default; omitting it returns 400 missing_chain.

depth.description: Position sizing ladder (same work as get_trade_depth)

sizesUsd.description: Ladder of sizes in USD, max 6

tokenAddress.description: Token you plan to buy, symbol or 0x address

quotecheck.description: Fairness audit of a third-party quote (same work as verify_quote_fairness)

quotedOut.description: RAW atomic units of tokenOut you were OFFERED

venueClaimed.description: Optional: who gave you the offer

route.description: Best execution book at one pinned block (same work as get_best_route)

amountIn.description: RAW atomic units of tokenIn, wei-scale, as a string

tokenIn.description: Token you are selling (symbol or 0x address)

tokenOut.description: Token you would receive (symbol or 0x address)

safety.description: Token sellability and contract facts (same work as check_token_safety)

intendedUsd.description: Size of intended purchase in USD (default 500)

offeredPriceUsd.description: Optional price per token someone offered you

tokenAddress.description: Token you plan to buy, symbol or 0x address

name: get_assurance
